# ABC (Australian Broadcasting Corporation)

> Australia's public broadcaster providing news, television, radio, streaming, education and emergency services across multiple platforms.

The ABC is Australia's national public broadcasting service offering comprehensive coverage of Australian and international news, entertainment, educational content, and emergency alerts. The organization operates multiple platforms including ABC News, iview streaming, ABC listen audio service, and specialized offerings for children and education.

## Key Topics

- ABC News
- ABC iview
- ABC listen
- Breaking news

## News & Breaking Coverage

- [ABC News & Headlines](https://www.abc.net.au): ABC's homepage with latest news headlines, breaking news and live coverage
- [Just In - ABC News](https://www.abc.net.au/news/justin): Live breaking news and in-depth coverage from Australia and worldwide
- [Politics - ABC News](https://www.abc.net.au/news/politics): Australian politics coverage, policy analysis and election news
- [ABC Emergency](https://www.abc.net.au/emergency): Emergency alerts and safety information for cyclones, floods and disasters

## Streaming & Media Platforms

- [ABC iview](https://iview.abc.net.au): ABC's streaming platform for on-demand TV, dramas, documentaries and news
- [ABC listen](https://www.abc.net.au/listen): ABC's audio streaming platform for podcasts, radio and audio content
- [ABC Television Guide](https://www.abc.net.au/tv/epg): Complete TV guide and electronic program guide for all ABC channels

## Education & Children's Content

- [ABC Education](https://www.abc.net.au/education): Curriculum-linked educational resources for primary and secondary students
- [ABC Kids](https://www.abc.net.au/abckids): ABC Kids preschool programs, games, activities and educational content

## Corporate & Information

- [About the ABC](https://www.abc.net.au/about): ABC history, governance, management, corporate reports and media centre
- [More from your ABC](https://www.abc.net.au/more): Navigation hub and directory for ABC's services and content offerings
- [ABC Shop](https://www.abc.net.au/shop): ABC's online store for books, merchandise, music and commercial products

## Policies & Accessibility

- [ABC Editorial Policies](https://www.abc.net.au/edpols): ABC editorial policies, code of practice and content standards
- [ABC Accessibility Statement](https://www.abc.net.au/about/accessibility-statement/103700726): WCAG 2.2 accessibility compliance statement and assistive technology info
